instruction: Speak in Italian. Your tone should evolve from indifferent to heavily sarcastic. The sarcasm should build gradually, not be present from the start.
text: Va bene, ho sentito quello che hai detto. È un approccio interessante, non c'è che dire. Ci devo riflettere un attimo. Oh sì, è chiaramente la soluzione perfetta a tutti i nostri problemi. Fantastico.

target_values.tone: start indifferent, but gradually become more sarcastic

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The delivery is completely flat and robotic throughout. There is no trace of indifference, sarcasm, or any dynamic evolution in tone.

instruction_evidence.indifferent_start: The voice is robotic and devoid of human emotion, rather than intentionally indifferent.
instruction_evidence.sarcastic_progression: There is no build-up of sarcasm; the tone remains monotonously flat and synthetic until the end.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The audio sounds extremely synthetic with severe pronunciation issues and robotic cadence.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: There is zero expressiveness or variation in the delivery.

instruction: Speak in Italian. Start with a cheerful voice at a normal conversational speed. Then, slow your pace and become more reflective. For the final part, maintain the slow pace but let your voice fill with sadness.
text: Ah, quella canzone! Mi riporta subito a quella festa, che serata magnifica fu. Ballammo tutta la notte senza un pensiero al mondo. Era un momento perfetto, uno di quelli che credi non finiranno mai. Peccato che sia finito.

target_values.emotion: start happy, become thoughtful in the middle, and end on a sad note
target_values.speed: start normal, slow down in the middle, and remain slow

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The delivery is completely flat and robotic, failing to exhibit the requested dynamic progression in both emotion and speed.

instruction_evidence.emotion_progression: The voice is monotonous throughout the entire clip, with no audible shift from cheerful to reflective to sad.
instruction_evidence.speed_progression: The pacing remains uniform from start to finish; it never slows down as instructed.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The audio sounds highly synthetic, stiff, and lacks humanlike speech qualities.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery is entirely flat and lacks any expressive variation.

instruction: Speak in Italian. Start speaking slowly and hesitantly, as if nervous. As you continue, your speed should become normal and your tone should grow firm and confident.
text: Uhm... buongiorno a tutti. Vorrei... vorrei iniziare ringraziandovi per essere qui oggi. Siamo riuniti per annunciare un'iniziativa di grande importanza per la nostra comunità, un progetto che porterà crescita e nuove opportunità per tutti.

target_values.speed: start slow and hesitant, then become a normal speaking speed
target_values.tone: start hesitant, then become firm and confident

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio completely fails to follow the dynamic instruction. It is extremely fast and garbled from the beginning, showing no slow, hesitant start nor any progression in confidence.

instruction_evidence.speed_progression: The speaking speed is extremely fast throughout the entire recording, completely ignoring the instruction to start slowly.
instruction_evidence.tone_progression: There is no transition from a hesitant tone to a firm and confident one; the delivery remains flat, robotic, and severely mispronounced.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Not applicable as instruction following is bad.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Not applicable as instruction following is bad.

instruction: Speak in Italian. Tell the story by starting at a normal pace and pitch, then speeding up and raising your pitch for the exciting middle part, and finally slowing down and lowering your pitch back to normal for the calm ending.
text: La gara stava per finire, ed eravamo secondi. All'ultima curva, il nostro pilota ha visto un'apertura, un'occasione quasi impossibile. Ha spinto l'acceleratore al massimo, ha superato il rivale all'interno con una manovra da brivido e ha tagliato il traguardo per primo! Dopo tutta quella tensione, la vittoria è stata ancora più dolce.

target_values.pitch: start normal, rise to high in the middle, then return to normal
target_values.speed: start normal, get fast in the middle, then slow down at the end

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio fails to realize the requested temporal progression. Instead of starting normal, speeding up, and slowing down, the pace is uniformly fast and robotic, and the audio suffers from severe glitches and repetitions at the end.

instruction_evidence.pitch_progression: The pitch remains relatively flat and synthetic throughout, with no clear rise in the middle or return to a lower pitch at the end.
instruction_evidence.speed_progression: The pace does not follow the requested dynamic arc; it stays consistently fast and disjointed before breaking down into glitches.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech is highly robotic, contains severe artifacts, and loops/repeats text at the end.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: There is no expressive shaping; the delivery is flat, glitchy, and fails to convey the excitement of the story.

instruction: Speak in Italian. Begin your speech at a slow tempo, and steadily accelerate until you're speaking very quickly by the final words.
text: All'inizio era solo un sussurro, il vento tra le foglie. Poi le prime gocce di pioggia, rade e pesanti. Le nuvole si sono addensate, oscurando il cielo, e il tuono in lontananza è diventato un rombo costante e vicino, fino a scatenare tutta la sua furia sulla città.

target_values.speed: start slow, gradually accelerate to very fast by the end

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The speech remains at a similarly slow, choppy pace throughout the entire audio and completely fails to accelerate to a fast tempo by the end.

instruction_evidence.start_slow: The beginning is indeed delivered at a slow tempo.
instruction_evidence.accelerate_to_very_fast: There is no noticeable acceleration; the final words are delivered just as slowly and with heavy pauses, failing the requested progression.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Not applicable as instruction following is bad. The speech is highly robotic and choppy.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Not applicable as instruction following is bad.

instruction: Speak in Italian. Your voice should build in urgency. Start at a normal level and gradually increase your speed and volume, making your tone more and more insistent.
text: Vi informiamo che è stata rilevata una criticità nel sistema di contenimento. Il personale sta monitorando la situazione, ma per precauzione è necessario agire ora. Abbandonate l'edificio usando le uscite di emergenza, non usate gli ascensori, muovetevi in fretta!

target_values.speed: progress from normal to very fast
target_values.volume: progress from normal to very loud

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio fails to realize the requested dynamic progression. There is no noticeable increase in speed, volume, or urgency, and the delivery is monotonous.

instruction_evidence.speed: The speech rate remains relatively constant throughout, with no clear progression to very fast.
instruction_evidence.volume: The volume does not increase to very loud.
instruction_evidence.tone: The tone is flat and robotic, lacking any build-up in urgency.

instruction: Speak in Italian. Start with a worried tone. Then, as you continue, transition to a tone of surprise. End the sentence sounding very happy and relieved.
text: Non ho ancora ricevuto nessuna notizia, spero davvero che non sia successo niente di grave. Aspetta un attimo, è arrivata una mail... non posso crederci. È incredibile, ce l'abbiamo fatta! È la notizia migliore che potessi ricevere!

target_values.emotion: begin worried, then transition to surprised, and end happy

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio is highly robotic and flat, completely failing to convey the requested dynamic transitions from worried to surprised to happy.

instruction_evidence.worried_start: The beginning is completely flat and lacks any worried tone.
instruction_evidence.surprise_middle: The transition to surprise is absent; the delivery remains robotic.
instruction_evidence.happy_end: The ending sounds just as synthetic and expressionless as the rest, with no happiness or relief audible.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech is extremely synthetic, robotic, and contains unnatural mispronunciations.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery is totally flat with zero expressive variation.

instruction: Speak in Italian. Your delivery should sound like you're losing energy. Begin loud and fast, but end very quiet and slow.
text: Non riesco a credere a tutto quello che ho fatto oggi, un'impresa dopo l'altra senza un minuto di pausa! Mi sentivo invincibile, capace di conquistare il mondo. Ma ora che tutto è finito, sento tutta la stanchezza che mi crolla addosso... sono completamente esausto.

target_values.speed: start fast and end very slow
target_values.volume: start loud and end very quiet

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio fails to realize the requested dynamic progression. While it starts loud and fast, it does not become quiet and slow at the end. Furthermore, the speech is heavily distorted, robotic, and fails to convey the impression of losing energy.

instruction_evidence.speed_progression: The pace remains relatively fast and erratic throughout; it does not noticeably slow down at the end.
instruction_evidence.volume_progression: The volume remains loud and consistent, failing to become very quiet by the end.

instruction: Speak in Italian. The delivery should start high-pitched and pleading, but shift decisively to a low-pitched, firm and defiant tone for the final part.
text: Potresti almeno considerare quello che sto dicendo? È importante per me, davvero. Ho seguito le tue regole finora, ho fatto quello che volevi. Ma questa volta, le cose cambiano. Io scelgo per me stessa.

target_values.tone: start with a pleading tone, then become defiant

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The delivery is completely flat and monotonous throughout. It fails to convey the high-pitched pleading tone at the beginning and lacks the shift to a low-pitched defiant tone at the end.

instruction_evidence.pitch_shift: The pitch remains steady and relatively flat from start to finish.
instruction_evidence.tone_change: No pleading or defiant tone is perceptible; the speech is entirely emotionless.

instruction: Speak in Italian. Start in a quiet, sad voice. About halfway through, your tone should shift to become loud and angry.
text: Ricordo ancora le loro promesse, le parole gentili che mi dissero quel giorno. Ci ho creduto, ho dato tutto quello che avevo. E poi, il silenzio. Mi hanno lasciato solo, hanno preso tutto e non si sono nemmeno guardati indietro. Non lo perdonerò mai! Mai!

target_values.emotion: start sad, then shift to angry
target_values.volume: start quiet, then become very loud

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio demonstrates a dynamic shift in volume, starting quieter and becoming louder halfway through. However, the emotional shift from sad to angry is very weak and flattened due to the highly robotic and unnatural delivery.

instruction_evidence.start_sad_quiet: The audio begins at a lower volume, but the tone is flat and synthetic rather than audibly sad.
instruction_evidence.shift_loud_angry: Around halfway through, the volume noticeably increases and the pace quickens, but the expression of anger is shallow and lacks richness.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech is extremely unnatural, robotic, and suffers from severe synthetic artifacts and poor prosody.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery is flat and lacks nuanced, human-like emotional variation.
